verdict.rationale: Toolchain version management is a fair question for a JavaScript package manager, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents installing npm package dependencies from package.json and bun.lock. Nothing shows Bun installing or switching language runtimes or tool versions per project from a checked-in config. Global installs (`-g`) and lockfile pinning are adjacent package-dependency features, not runtime or toolchain switching.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install and switch language runtimes or tool versions per project from a checked-in config file
